points.point: The Vault's Wi-Fi 7 workflow splits CMX500 (R&D signaling/interworking) from CMP180 (production non-signaling RF), i.e. signaling tester early, non-signaling tester at production.
points.label: covered
points.why: places CMX500 in R&D/signaling and CMP180 later/non-signaling/production handoff

points.point: In the production phase all WLAN RF measurements are run in non-signaling mode to save test time, and the CMP180 is positioned as optimized for that stage.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMP180 non-signaling and production context, but not that all production WLAN RF measurements use non-signaling to save time or that CMP180 is optimized for it

points.point: Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode with real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics (MLO makes multiple RF chains important).
points.label: partial
points.why: says CMX500 is for R&D signaling/operation testing, but omits real-world conditions, RF TX/RX measurements, and MLO/multiple RF chains

points.point: For Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, the first RF tests were implemented in CMX500 signaling mode before final IEEE standard ratification, on a Broadcom prototype WLAN device.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions Wi-Fi 8 CMX500 testing and Broadcom prototype, but omits before final ratification and only vaguely covers first RF signaling tests

points.point: Wi-Fi 8 signaling-mode tests target PHY features such as distributed resource units (dRU) and unequal modulation (UEQM), i.e. pre-standard PHY validation rather than production screening.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions Wi-Fi 8 PHY features generally, but not dRU/UEQM or explicitly pre-standard validation rather than production

points.point: The 5G device testing value chain note maps the same tool split generically: signaling/protocol/application layer = CMX500/CMW500/CMsquares; production/manufacturing = CMP180/CMP200/CMW100.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention the generic 5G value-chain split or CMW500/CMsquares/CMP200/CMW100

points.point: CMX500 Wi-Fi signaling coverage is licensed per Wi-Fi generation, e.g. WLAN Signaling 11be options for Wi-Fi 7 AP or station emulation, alongside WLAN TX measurement and ARB generator options.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention per-generation CMX500 licensing or 11be AP/station, TX measurement, ARB options

points.point: CMP180's non-signaling production scope covers Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz; its 480 MHz loopback waveform is only a potential Wi-Fi 8 candidate, not confirmed Wi-Fi 8 production support.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMP180 480 MHz loopback waveform, but omits Wi-Fi 6E/7, 5G NR FR1, 8 GHz/500 MHz scope and the caveat that 480 MHz is only a potential Wi-Fi 8 candidate

invented: CMP180 應放在 Wi‑Fi 7/8 後段 RF waveform / loopback 驗證與 R&D-to-production 銜接的位置
